objective: LungVision AI — Phase 5 Patient-Specific Dual-View 3D Lung Shape Reconstruction from Paired Radiographs.
acceptance_criteria: Gate A: Multi-Patient SSM & Correspondence Governance (Audit 430 patient cohort with 301 train / 64 val / 65 test split; verify canonical template, bilateral partitioning, 16 anatomical landmarks, Generalized Procrustes Analysis, and export ssm_lung_pca_v2.json).
Gate B: Paired Dual-View Input Pipeline (Ingest Frontal PA/AP and Lateral LL radiographs with view identity, aspect ratio, patient pairing validation, and mismatch rejection).

Gate C: Controlled Shape Parameter Prediction (Implement and benchmark Frontal-only, Lateral-only, Dual-view concatenation fusion, and Dual-view cross-attention fusion models predicting M=20 SSM coefficients with zero CT metadata leakage).

Gate D: Patient-Specific 3D Reconstruction Service (Continuous surface synthesis s = mean + P*b, left/right lung partitioning, divergence theorem volumetry, vertex uncertainty estimation, and experimental REST endpoint /api/v1/reconstruction/3d/patient-specific).

Gate E: Held-Out CT Surface Validation (Rigorous evaluation across 65 held-out test patients against reference CT segmentations: Dice, ASSD, HD95, Volume Error %, Landmark Error, 95% CIs, and Frontal vs Dual-view ablation).

Gate F: Research Dashboard Integration (Interactive DualViewXRayPage with paired upload, patient verification, 3D predicted mesh rendering, Left/Right toggle, CT ground truth comparison, quantitative scorecard, and non-diagnostic disclaimer).

Gate G: Comprehensive Automated Verification (Complete test suite covering split integrity, mesh correspondence, PCA boundaries, paired input, shape prediction, 3D reconstruction, volume calculation, API isolation, and frontend UI).
non_goals: Do not modify or retrain frozen DenseNet121 weights (8d3690cd...)
Do not alter frozen NIH production classification thresholds
Do not download 220 GB LUNA16 raw CT scans locally; use verified manifest and cloud-hybrid processing
Do not use CT spacing, CT dimensions, or mask metadata as predictor inputs (prevent shortcut learning)
Never display predicted 3D mesh as an actual CT scan or claim diagnostic CT synthesis
